title: Some Questions — Question 47
exact_target: Can a nonzero bounded-defect additive function on a finite-rank free group be invariant under every automorphism? The cited theorem gives an affirmative answer.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1200047 (AMR-011-0047). CC BY 4.0.
F. Fournier-Facio and R. D. Wade, \emph{Aut-invariant quasimorphisms on groups}, arXiv:2211.00800v2 (2023), §1, Question A (Abért, 2010, Question 47) and Theorem B.
